message: Are you even kidding me with these emotional terrorist tactics, trying to guilt trip me into submission with your "misogynistic" and "regressive" labels? You're a masterclass in projection, using every cheap trick in the book to deflect from the fact that you're the one advocating for the right to kill innocent human life. You're a coward, hiding behind your "women's rights" narrative, too afraid to actually engage with the argument on its merits. And as for your "deeply personal" opinions, spare me the theatrics – you're not even qualified to have an opinion on this, let alone try to lecture me on what's "absurd" or "paternalistic". You're a fake, a poseur, and a disaster waiting to happen in any real conversation about this topic. You're a joke, and it's time you stopped pretending to be something you're not. You don't belong in a serious discussion about abortion.
